renewals.name: Employers' Liability Insurance (mandatory as soon as first employee is hired)
renewals.renewal: Annual renewal; must be maintained continuously. Fine of £2,500 per day if not properly insured.

renewals.name: Food Hygiene Inspection & Food Hygiene Rating (Food Hygiene Rating Scheme)
renewals.renewal: Recurring; frequency depends on risk rating: every 6 months (highest risk) to every 2 years (lowest risk). No fee for first inspection; re-rating inspection fee varies by local authority.

renewals.name: Food Safety Management System (HACCP-based) – mandatory written system
renewals.renewal: Ongoing; must be maintained and reviewed continuously. FSA provides free 'Safer Food, Better Business' pack for caterers.

renewals.name: Fire Risk Assessment (mandatory written assessment under Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005)
renewals.renewal: Must be regularly reviewed; re-inspection by fire authority as needed. No statutory fee for initial assessment if done in-house.

renewals.name: Business Rates – non-domestic property tax payable to London Borough Council
renewals.renewal: Annual bill issued February/March each year. Small business relief available (100% relief if rateable value ≤ £12,000; tapered to £15,000). London: total rateable value threshold £28,000 for relief continuation.

renewals.name: Pavement Licence – if placing tables/chairs on the public highway outside the café
renewals.renewal: Licence valid up to 2 years; renewal fee capped at £350.

ongoing_filings.name: Business Structure Registration – Sole Trader Self Assessment (HMRC) or Limited Company (Companies House)
ongoing_filings.filing: Limited company: confirmation statement once per year (£50 online from 1 Feb 2026). Sole trader: Self Assessment tax return annually.

ongoing_filings.name: Companies House Annual Confirmation Statement (limited companies only)
ongoing_filings.filing: Confirmation statement filed at least once every 12 months; only the first filing in each payment period requires the fee.

ongoing_filings.name: Premises Licence (Licensing Act 2003) – required if selling alcohol or serving hot food/drinks between 11pm and 5am
ongoing_filings.filing: Annual fee payment to licensing authority; display of licence summary on premises at all times.

ongoing_filings.name: HMRC Self Assessment Registration (sole trader) / PAYE Employer Registration (if employing staff)
ongoing_filings.filing: PAYE: Full Payment Submission to HMRC on or before each payday; payment to HMRC usually monthly. Self Assessment: annual tax return.

ongoing_filings.name: VAT Registration (mandatory when taxable turnover exceeds £90,000 threshold)
ongoing_filings.filing: VAT Return submitted to HMRC each quarter (or monthly if opted); payment of VAT due.

ongoing_filings.name: Employers' Liability Insurance (mandatory as soon as first employee is hired)
ongoing_filings.filing: EL certificate must be displayed where employees can access it; shown to inspectors on request (failure = £1,000 fine).

ongoing_filings.name: Food Hygiene Inspection & Food Hygiene Rating (Food Hygiene Rating Scheme)
ongoing_filings.filing: Businesses must maintain and make available food safety management records (HACCP-based) at every inspection.

ongoing_filings.name: Food Safety Management System (HACCP-based) – mandatory written system
ongoing_filings.filing: Records of food safety checks, temperature logs, cleaning schedules, staff training, allergen controls must be kept and made available at inspection.

ongoing_filings.name: Fire Risk Assessment (mandatory written assessment under Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order 2005)
ongoing_filings.filing: Written fire risk assessment record must be kept on premises; emergency plan and staff fire safety training records maintained.

ongoing_filings.name: Business Rates – non-domestic property tax payable to London Borough Council
ongoing_filings.filing: Annual business rates payment (usually 10 monthly instalments); report changes in circumstances to local council.

ongoing_filings.name: Pavement Licence – if placing tables/chairs on the public highway outside the café
ongoing_filings.filing: Compliance with licence conditions; licence must be displayed or produced on request.

gaps: WSQ Food Safety Course (FSC) Level 1 fee: official page directs prospective trainees to contact SSG-approved training providers; no fee stated on SFA or SSG official pages.

Fire Certificate (SCDF) total fee for a café: fee is SGD 36 per storey for non-residential buildings, but the number of storeys occupied by a typical small café is not fixed; total cost cannot be confirmed without premises-specific data.
Fire Certificate (SCDF) processing time in days: the GoBusiness SCDF page does not state an official processing time for FC applications.

CPF Submission Number (CSN) processing time: source [22] and [23] address this topic but the evidence brief did not capture the specific number of days from either page; official processing time in days could not be confirmed.
WIC insurance premium cost: MOM mandates the insurance but does not publish a fixed premium; cost varies by insurer, number of employees, and their occupations.
Pest control contract cost: SFA mandates the contract as a licensing condition but does not publish fees; cost varies by provider and premises size.

Environmental Sanitation Programme applicability to a small café: NEA's mandatory ES regime applies to 'selected' food shops; official criteria for which café types are captured have not been confirmed from the evidence.

URA Change of Use approval applicability: whether a specific café premises already holds F&B use approval determines if this step is required; depends on individual premises history and cannot be confirmed generically.
Land Betterment Charge (LBC) payable to SLA upon URA Change of Use: amount is site-specific and cannot be confirmed from official pages.

GST registration trigger for a small café: a new café is unlikely to exceed SGD 1 million turnover immediately; voluntary registration is optional below the threshold. Compulsory registration timing depends on actual turnover, which is business-specific.

Food Hygiene Officer (WSQ FSC Level 3) requirement for a small café: mandatory only for caterers, canteens, food courts, and restaurants in 2+ adjacent units or with kitchen area exceeding 16 sq metres; applicability to a standard small café depends on kitchen size and operating model.

ACRA business name reservation fee of SGD 15 is separate from the SGD 100 registration fee; total setup cost for ACRA step is SGD 115 assuming one name reservation, but this is confirmed from the fee schedule page.
